remarks: A chic pied-a-terre designed for luxury, this 2 bed, 2 bath end unit offers four exposures, & exceptional privacy. Renovated in 2023, the home features an open living and dining layout with refinished hardwood floors, custom built-ins, and brand-new windows. The chef's kitchen is elegantly composed with bespoke cabinetry, marble surfaces, Ann Sacks tile, Thermador appliances, and a Miele built-in refrigerator/freezer. Additional features include your private balcony, full-size washer and dryer, new Mitsubishi HVAC mini split system, custom window treatments, on-site parking, and private basement storage. Walking distance to Greenwich Avenue boutiques, cafes, fine dining, parks, train, and waterfront. This true turnkey delivers effortless living in a prime in-town location and is poised to be claimed quickly.
